card.title: Steer the Suspicion
card.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shelf fell because they supplied the wrong bracket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You fitted it upside down. Look at the arrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a misleading arrow. We should photograph it for the manufacturer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You drew that arrow. I watched you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because theirs was missing. Put that in the complaint; they made us supply our own safety markings.

mechanism: A moves responsibility for a failed shelf from supplied hardware to markings and finally the manufacturer's missing guidance.
confusable: Unlike disputing a clue's existence, A must absorb each clue into a new external explanation.
comparison: A personally drawn arrow becomes alleged evidence of missing safety marks, distinct from claiming a pen was damaged by delivery.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
